supersedes.note: A01-AUTO-2 widens A01-AUTO-1 by Michael's HUMAN_FINAL approval above (chat, 2026-11-20 9:15 AM Pacific). A REG-accepted HUMAN_FINAL switch-ON naming exactly this superseded version and sha256 also covers A01-AUTO-2; a switch-OFF still turns it off. One step only: no other version or hash is covered. A01-AUTO-1 receipts already in the ledger replay under the A01-AUTO-1 rules.

switch: ON and OFF are each a governed AUTO_POLICY_SWITCH record that only a HUMAN_FINAL APPROVE + REG acceptance makes effective. The switch names this file's sha256; a changed file is a new policy and is OFF until switched on again. Exception: the single superseded version named in "supersedes" (HUMAN_FINAL-approved carry-over).

classes.rule: source_kind SOURCE_UPLOAD from governed_source_upload; source_sha256 is 64 hex; the preserved descriptor's SHA256, PATH, TITLE and BYTES lines equal the record and the descriptor hash equals the record's source hash; when the file itself is present under UNIFUSION_SOURCES_ROOT its sha256 must match too; no Archonym; CAP exactly OBS; risk L; RECOIL and WVC passed; no facets, Supersedes, build graph, monetization or authority REL keys; no other record shares its source_sha256.

Another record (any state) already carries the same source_sha256 (SOURCE_UPLOAD) or the same preserved source hash, and that record is decided or has the smaller IDN. HOLD only; RESUME is one HUMAN_FINAL press.
Generated provider-combination / trajectory record (REL source_name provider_population). HOLD only, never accepted; RESUME is one HUMAN_FINAL press.

Worker-derived SOURCE_KIN_LINK (topic or kin) from worker_source_kin_link whose two distinct ends are existing SOURCE_UPLOAD records from governed_source_upload in any state except rejected (AtGOV, approved, accepted or returned; held ends fall under WORKER_NOISE); both ends are real canon documents sharing a topic (quality rules); preserved descriptor FROM/TO equal the record; no Archonym; CAP exactly OBS; risk L; RECOIL and WVC passed; no facets, Supersedes, build graph, monetization or authority REL keys.

Worker SOURCE_INSIGHT from worker_source_insight whose cited sources (insight_of and every insight_kin ID) are existing SOURCE_UPLOAD records from governed_source_upload in any state except rejected; the insight's source passes the quality rules; preserved descriptor is SOURCE_INSIGHT/1 with OF and KIN equal to the record; no Archonym; CAP exactly OBS; risk L; RECOIL and WVC passed; no facets, Supersedes, build graph, monetization or authority REL keys.

A worker SOURCE_KIN_LINK or SOURCE_INSIGHT that passes the structural guard but fails the quality rules below: a link or insight end that is not a real document (title empty, an ID or hash, a raw path, or containing a raw_title_marker), that is on hold (HELD) or non-canon (title contains a non_canon_title_term), or a link whose ends share neither a non-generic source_topic nor a meaningful title term. HOLD only (generated noise); RESUME is one HUMAN_FINAL press.

quality.note: Worker quality rules (A01-AUTO-2, added by owner request 2026-11-20). The worker skips these sources and the policy refuses (HOLDs) worker records that cite them.

never: any record that changes authority (Supersedes, COMPOSITION_KIN, kin_emergion, capability providers, targets, requirements)
wire keys, the GOV gate, the policy itself (AUTO_POLICY_SWITCH)
money or external actions (action authorizations stay HUMAN_FINAL)
undo: REVERT: one HUMAN_FINAL press moves an AUTO_POLICY-accepted record from REG-accepted to HELD (append-only). An AUTO_POLICY HOLD is undone with the existing HUMAN_FINAL RESUME.
